scope: Bounded average conversion characteristics at two separately published operating conditions. No cross-slice voltage interpolation, self-oscillation, receiver supply coupling or tracking.

sources.title: Sylvania Technical Manual, 1951
sources.readings: Manual approximate graph readings; training coordinates and withheld coordinates are distinct, but share the same printed curves. Not independent physical measurements.

sources.title: Sylvania 7A8 Technical Data, May 12 1947
sources.notes: The 250 V oscillator-anode entry is a supply applied through 20 kohm, not the electrode voltage. Typical operating data use 6.3 V heaters; the nominal ratings heading separately says 7.0 V. Neither changes the existing receiver heater model.

bias_100v.label: 100 V plate/anode, 75 V screen · signal bias

drive_250v.label: 250 V plate/supply, 100 V screen · oscillator drive

fixture_contract.signal: RF grid voltage is imposed by an ideal source; LO is a normalized externally imposed clock, not an oscillator-grid voltage. Its amplitude is NOT inferred from mean oscillator-grid current.
fixture_contract.conversion_law: i_ac = 2 * Gc * v_rf(t) * cos(2*pi*f_lo*t); the factor two yields Gc * RF-peak at the difference-frequency component. A behavioral small-signal frequency translator, not instantaneous tube electron dynamics.
fixture_contract.output: Unloaded plate AC current only, with no IF network, output resistance or capacitance loading. Reference DC currents are separately labeled and only available on the 100 V bias slice with the stated excitation; disabled LO invalidates these DC references.
fixture_contract.numerics: Coherent 2 ms window, frequencies on a 1 kHz grid, trapezoidal Fourier projection from full-rate states; plots decimated independently.

limits: No unsupported extrapolation or interpolation between supply/drive slices.
No positive-grid, heater-dependent, stopped-oscillator DC, large-signal, plate/screen-voltage surface or source-loading model.
Manufacturer interelectrode capacitances and finite plate resistance are not stamped in this unloaded current fixture.
Existing coupled receiver converter substitutes remain unchanged.
No oscillator coupling resolution, aerial network, tuning/tracking, AVC feedback or full EC closure.
